text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock owners and deps for the new ratecard rollout. target: docs + metering hooks by next Wed. who owns the billing pipeline changes?

Jordan: I can take billing pipeline changes (ETL + write schema). timeline looks like 3 days once spec is final. pinging @Alex for metering events mapping. :calendar:

Alex: @Jordan noted. I still need clarity on event names for tiered discounts vs. committed units. can we standardize to `ratecard_event` with tags?

Maya: yes prefer `ratecard_event` + `tier` tag. Also need contract-safe pricing behavior: if contract caps price we should route to dedicated pricing table. Priya owns contract checks, right?

Priya: Yep I own contract logic. two quick constraints: 1) legacy contracts (pre-2024) must map to legacy_rate_id; 2) any cap overrides billing calculation. I'll share a mapping table by tomorrow.

Sam: small heads-up — quota service currently reads usages in UTC day boundaries. if ratecard has mid-day tier switches we need to decide attribution window.

Jordan: Good catch. For invoice correctness we should attribute by event timestamp but also keep aggregation windows aligned to contract timezone. That will affect ETL group-by.

Alex: Example mapping I'm proposing:
```
{
  "event_name": "ratecard_event",
  "tags": {"tier": "pro|enterprise|committed", "rate_id": "r123"},
  "amount": "tokens",
  "contract_id": "c789"
}
```
This will let billing join on contract_id and apply caps. Thoughts?

Maya: That schema looks good. Jordan, can billing schema add `contract_id` index and `tier`? we need query perf for month-end runs.

Jordan: yes can add indexes. will also include a lightweight partition by month. will need ~4GB extra storage estimate for first 6mo.

Priya: sending sample mapping now (will drop a gdoc). Also note legal requires audit log of overridden prices. add `price_override_reason` field.

Sam: For quota service: adding `tier` to aggregation keys is fine but we need a char limit (current plan 32 chars). ok?

Alex: tiers are short, that's fine. one more item: SDK change — we will expose `rate_id` in response metadata for customers to reconcile. who owns SDK bump?

Maya: DevEx/SDK team will cut a minor. Alex can file a brief PR and ping DevEx.

Alex: will prepare PR today. small code snippet for server-side header change:
```http
X-Redwood-RateId: r123
X-Redwood-Tier: enterprise
```

Jordan: blockers: need final mapping doc + contract list to validate indexes. once I have those can ETA the data migration.

Maya: action items: 1) Priya share mapping & legacy contract list (due tomorrow) 2) Alex file SDK PR (EOD) 3) Jordan update schema + storage estimate (2d after doc) 4) Sam confirm quota window behavior and char limit (tomorrow). I'll coordinate canary rollout plan after these.

Priya: got it. I'll post doc and tag you all.

billing-bot: NOTE: scheduled migration window requested: 2026-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC — reply with APPROVE to lock.

Maya: Approve for planning, final ok after Jordan confirms migration steps. :white_check_mark:

Sam: I ran a quick local test of window attribution — looks good, just need to handle daylight savings edge-case in TZ mapping. will include test in PR. :mag:

Alex: thanks everyone. I’ll ping DevEx and drop PR link here when ready.

Jordan: once PR + mapping landed I'll queue a dry-run and share results in #eng-runtime.

Maya: perfect. if anything slips tag this thread. thanks all. :pray:
